home.description: A contextual radial menu for Windows. Open it with a hotkey to quickly access actions for the currently active application.

hero.description: The right tools, at the right moment. A radial menu that adapts to your workflow.

wheel.title: Interactive radial menu demo
wheel.description: Choose a sector to preview an illustrative action. This demo does not execute commands or describe confirmed app features.
wheel.caption: Demo · Illustrative actions
wheel.hint: Hover, tap, or use the arrow keys
wheel.keyboardHint: Tab to enter or leave the wheel. Arrow keys move between sectors. Home and End move to the first and last sector. Enter or Space previews an action. Escape clears the selection. Pressing outside the wheel also clears the selection.
